REGULAR MAZDOOR RECRUITMENT EXAMINATION, 2025
NOTICE
No.- 39/R&A Dated: 16th June, 2025
In continuation of the Court’s Notice No. 28/R&A dated 08th May, 2025, all candidates
are hereby informed that Admit card for Written Test under the Regular Mazdoor
Recruitment Examination, 2025 have been uploaded on Court’s official website through a
link available there. The candidates are directed to download the same using login credentials
and go through the details mentioned therein. The eligible candidates are also being intimated
through SMS/ e-mail on their registered mobile number/ e-mail ID in this regard.
Date, Slot and Centre of Examination allotted to the candidates is final and no
communication with regard to change of the same shall be entertained.
Admit card would not be sent to the candidates separately through any other mode.
The candidates are directed to strictly follow the instructions mentioned in the Admit
Card. They are also directed to paste their passport size photograph at the space provided in
the admit card. Candidates are also required to bring their valid identity proof in original with
its photocopy at the examination centre.
No TA/DA will be paid for appearing at the examination.
The candidates are advised to keep visiting the Court’s website:
https://patnahighcourt.gov.in/ regularly for further details / updates.
By order of the Court
Sd/-
Registrar General
